newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Port conditions update - Tanzania - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Tanzania - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

DAR ES SALAAM, Oct 29 - Port to resume handling oil tankers after being unable to do so for several months because offshore pumping facility out of operation. Harbour too shallow for large tankers, forcing them to unload at floating platform, which has been inoperative since August after developing leaks. One tanker laden with 85,000 tonnes of crude destined for Zambia waiting to discharge for past two months. Port officials said three tankers waiting to offload 250,000 tonnes of crude over next few days.
